title: FETCH CHILD and FETCH ANY with NOSUSPEND: NOTFINISHED RESP2 52 while the child runs, NORMAL once it has completed, NOTFND once all are fetched, INVREQ RESP2 52 with no children

scenarios.summary: FETCH CHILD NOSUSPEND right after RUN: NOTFINISHED with RESP2 52, the parent is not suspended; after the parent waits 10 s (the child takes 5) the same FETCH is NORMAL
FETCH ANY NOSUSPEND: NOTFINISHED 52 while the child runs, NORMAL with the child token after it, then NOTFND RESP2 1 as no unfetched child is left
FETCH ANY NOSUSPEND by a task that has run no child: INVREQ with RESP2 52, not NOTFINISHED
